description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Archeops
description: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

name: Trubbish
description: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Garbodor
description: Ancient tribes fashioned this Pokémon from clay found along Mt. Ignis. It has been active for over two milennia.

name: Zorua
description: The ancient civilisation that resided in Orbtus a thousand years ago commanded this Pokémon to protect them.

name: Zoroark
description: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Minccino
description: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Cinccino
description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Gothita
description: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their fights help them become stronger.

name: Gothorita
description: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Gothitelle
description: Their wings are too tiny to allow them to fly. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

name: Solosis
description: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened prey on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Duosion
description: It breathes through a hole in its tail while it burns with an internal fire. It preys on Durant.

name: Reuniclus
description: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves from Heatmor.

name: Ducklett
description: Lacking sight, its unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Swanna
description: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Vanillite
description: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Vanillish
description: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking foes.

name: Vanilluxe
description: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Deerling
description: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Sawsbuck
description: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon.

name: Emolga
description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.

name: Karrablast
description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away.

name: Escavalier
description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

name: Foongus
description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Amoonguss
description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.

name: Frillish
description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Jellicent
description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Alomomola
description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Joltik
description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

name: Galvantula
description: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Ferroseed
description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become sharp enough to pierce rock.

name: Ferrothorn
description: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

name: Klink
description: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

name: Klang
description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Klinklang
description: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

name: Tynamo
description: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

name: Eelektrik
description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it takes when attacked.

name: Eelektross
description: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minutes time.

name: Elgyem
description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. These stars can split metal in two.

name: Beheeyem
description: It digs burrows with its sizable ears. It sometimes spends all night digging in fields, seeking out treasure.

name: Litwick
description: Its powerful ears can reduce bedrock to rubble in mere seconds. It lounges lazily after a day's work of digging.

name: Lampent
description: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Chandelure
description: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Axew
description: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Fraxure
description: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: Haxorus
description: The beaks of bird Pokémon cant begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Cubchoo
description: The patterns on this Pokémons wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Beartic
description: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane.

name: Cryogonal
description: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Shelmet
description: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Accelgor
description: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.

name: Stunfisk
description: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from flowering plants.

name: Mienfoo
description: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: Mienshao
description: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Druddigon
description: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it cant help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Golett
description: It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies. It hates bullying.

name: Golurk
description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Pawniard
description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Bisharp
description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Bouffalant
description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword.

name: Rufflet
description: The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

name: Braviary
description: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. It is told in folklore to appear only to kings.

name: Vullaby
description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on its diet.

name: Mandibuzz
description: It emits scents its enemies dislike to gain an edge in battle. It can create scents both pleasant and foul.

name: Heatmor
description: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy.

name: Durant
description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It uses its sensitive sense of smell to help pastry chefs work.

name: Deino
description: Foes who stare at the flashing spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Zweilous
description: It wields hypnotic powers and uses them to force others to do whatever it wants.

name: Hydreigon
description: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Larvesta
description: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: Volcarona
description: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on unaware prey and then finish it off.

name: Cobalion
description: Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

name: Terrakion
description: They fire compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Virizion
description: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Tornadus
description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun.

name: Thundurus
description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a tower.

name: Reshiram
description: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up an automobile. It lived a long time ago.

name: Zekrom
description: Nothing could stop this Pokémon 100 million years ago, so it behaved like a king.

name: Landorus
description: This calm Pokémon lived in a cold land where there were no violent predators like Tyrantrum.

name: Kyurem
description: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponents attack.

name: Keldeo
description: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Meloetta
description: It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Genesect
description: It uses its tail to absorb electricity from power plants or from outlets in houses.

name: Chespin
description: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Quilladin
description: It's covered in a slimy membrane that makes any punches or kicks slide off it harmlessly.

name: Chesnaught
description: Its four horns are a high-performance radar system. It uses them to sense sounds and smells.

name: Fennekin
description: It attacks with retractable horns. It throws a punch that's the equivalent of the force of a hundred pro boxers.

name: Braixen
description: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Delphox
description: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. It prefers to live in abandoned forests.

name: Froakie
description: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.

name: Frogadier
description: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.

name: Greninja
description: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.

name: Bunnelby
description: Fortified ice shields its body. It rebuilds any cracks with air of, at its coldest, -150 degrees Farenheit.

name: Diggersby
description: When multiple Bergmite congregate on the back of this Pokémon, they form the shape of an icy aircraft carrier.

name: Fletchling
description: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Fletchindr
description: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

name: Talonflame
description: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Scatterbug
description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.

name: Spewpa
description: When the Kalos regions ecozystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: Vivillon
description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Litleo
description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Pyroar
description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
